excerpts.text: TripoSG is an advanced high-fidelity, high-quality and high-generalizability image-to-3D generation foundation model. It leverages large-scale rectified flow transformers, hybrid supervised training, and a high-quality dataset to achieve state-of-the-art performance in 3D shape generation.
- **High-Quality Dataset**: Trained on 2 million meticulously curated Image-SDF pairs, ensuring superior output quality
- [🤗 Diffusers](https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers) for their excellent diffusion model framework
